key.name: close-item
key.summary: Close an application tab or the focused window
key.description: Configurable global keyboard shortcut for close item.

key.name: quit-app
key.summary: Request that all windows of the focused app close
key.description: Configurable global keyboard shortcut for quit app.

key.name: tab-close-apps
key.summary: Applications that use native tab closing
key.description: Desktop application IDs or WM_CLASS values that should receive Ctrl+W instead of a window-close request. Matching is exact and case-insensitive, with an optional .desktop suffix. Overrides automatic detection of browsers and the built-in common tab-based apps.

key.name: window-close-apps
key.summary: Applications that close the focused window
key.description: Desktop application IDs or WM_CLASS values that should close the focused window. Matching is exact and case-insensitive, with an optional .desktop suffix. Takes precedence over tab-close-apps and automatic detection.
